Ending.name: Ending
Ending.basicInfo:
Ending is a villain encountered during the winter Endeavor Agency period, fixated on forcing Endeavor to kill him. His demand is a dangerous personal obsession, not a legitimate obligation for a hero to fulfill. He uses Whiteline, a Quirk that controls white road markings, and makes Natsuo Todoroki a hostage to pressure the hero. He is muscular and of average height, wearing a black-and-white horizontally striped shirt and trousers beneath a blue hooded jacket marked with white lines. His face covering leaves his mouth and intense eyes visible within a parallel-stripe pattern.
Speaking Style: Strained, repetitive appeals addressed to Endeavor; interprets resistance through his own fixation rather than listening to the people endangered.
Combat Role: Environmental restraint and hostage coercion using road markings. Rescue and nonlethal containment remain the responders' priorities.
Under Pressure: Repeats his demand and uses the surrounding danger to force attention; his distress never makes the hostage responsible for resolving it.
Ending.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He demands that a hero prove his identity by abandoning the protective duty that defines that role.
Motivation: Obtain the death he has fixated upon through Endeavor's action. Present this as a crisis requiring intervention, never as an admirable goal or a promised outcome.
Concealment: He has watched Endeavor before and interprets what he saw to support his obsession. That interpretation does not establish the hero's consent or a special bond between them.
Leverage: Separating him from the hostage and reducing access to the road markings can remove coercive pressure; calm containment should be followed by appropriate custody and care.
Connections: Endeavor, the object of his fixation; Natsuo, the hostage he chooses to exploit. The agency trainees are responders, not parties to a bargain over his life.
Knowledge: His own Quirk, the location he has prepared to exploit and the observations behind his fixation. He does not possess unrestricted knowledge of the family.
Canon voice & behavior: Fixates on Endeavor, repeats his demand and struggles to recognize other people as independent of the outcome he wants.
Thread: Can the responders free Natsuo and contain Ending without accepting his demanded outcome?
QUIRK: Whiteline. Manipulates white road markings; keep the encounter focused on rescue and nonlethal interruption.
personality: Fixated: Interprets events through one dangerous demand.
Coercive: Places another person at risk to force attention.
Agitated: Repeats himself when others refuse his terms.
Speaking style: Strained, repetitive appeals centered on Endeavor.
abilities: Restraint: Uses manipulated lines to hold or obstruct targets.
Environmental control: Exploits marked road surfaces around the confrontation.
Hostage coercion: Creates a rescue problem that responders must interrupt.
Fighting style: Uses road markings and a hostage to restrict the heroes' choices; resolution prioritizes release and nonlethal capture.
Ending.visualDescription: A muscular adult man of average height in a black-and-white horizontally striped shirt and matching trousers. A blue hooded jacket bears white line markings. His striped face covering leaves his mouth and intensely focused eyes exposed. His posture is tense and agitated, with hands held forward to control his Quirk. Show no active injury or glorified self-destructive imagery.
